panels.general_description: Case 1 stress and rest colour-coded perfusion image tiles before and after PTE with printed MBF and MPR numbers.
panels.detailed_description: Under the bold italic heading "Case 1" the panel is titled "Perfusion". Column headings read Pre-PTE and Post-PTE and row headings read STRESS and REST. Four rectangular dark-grey image tiles sit in a 2 by 2 grid. Each tile shows a ring-shaped band coloured from dark blue through cyan and green toward yellow and red, drawn around two oval light-grey regions, on a grey background with dark surroundings. White text in the lower part of each tile gives an LV value and an RV value, each preceded by "MBF =" and a number. A vertical colour bar to the right is labelled "(ml/g/min)" and its ticks read 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Below the grid, the rows "LV MPR" and "RV MPR" give one number under Pre-PTE and one under Post-PTE. In the Post-PTE STRESS tile the band shows more green and yellow with a few red spots than the Pre-PTE STRESS tile, which is mostly blue and cyan; the REST tiles are mostly blue in both columns.
